title: The Market League as a solo campaign
problem: The Market League is six plain games against computers; it does not teach the main decisions or give varied goals.
scope: Six authored stages with a fixed seed and events on set days: Village Square (undercut), Pasar Malam (the hawker's floor), The Hotel Order (bid for a standing order), and three more
A goal to clear each stage and three optional mastery goals
Short illustrated character moments with the real art
Rewards shown on the stall through the Stamp Book, Collection and Wardrobe
exclusions: No rule, price or card changes; rules version 20 (a stage only chooses which existing card comes on which day)

added: Six authored League stages (Village Square, Pasar Malam, The Hotel Order, Heatwave, Glut, Premium Buyers), each with a lesson, a host moment before and after, and three star goals
League stars (18) with a new trophy card and the titles Star Pupil and Star Trader

playerNotes: The Market League is now a six-stage campaign that teaches when to undercut, the night hawker, standing orders, heatwaves, gluts and premium buyers
Earn up to 3 stars a stage; replay a cleared stage for the stars you missed
